_meta.description: Site-side measurement contract. These five local events are what docs/assets/js/measure.js can record and what analytics-endpoint/server.py accepts. Counts only: no IP, no user agent, no referrer, no cookies, no visitor identifiers. The campaign ledger's five events (impression/click/session/order/refund) are a separate, report-only system — see data/ledger.json and decision D-P05.

events.name: outbound_click
events.definition: A visitor clicked a sponsored product link.

events.name: guide_read_75
events.definition: A reader scrolled through 75% of a guide.

events.name: category_click
events.definition: A reader clicked a category tile.

events.name: feed_click
events.definition: A reader clicked the RSS/feed link.

endpoint_contract.server_behavior: Validates the body, increments daily per-path counts, writes counts only. Never reads or stores the client address, user agent, referrer or cookies; writes no request log.
endpoint_contract.status: Deployable (analytics-endpoint/server.py), not yet hosted — F-19. While settings.analytics_endpoint is empty the site sends nothing anywhere; the browser-local log is for the visitor's own view only.
